result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a couple of visible layout concerns caused by content being clipped or obscured at the viewport edges.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlays the second restaurant card, hiding the lower portion of its image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so cards can be fully viewed above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontally scrolling category and restaurant carousels are visibly cut off at the right edge, including a partial category pill and truncated restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling is intentional and add a subtle scroll affordance or spacing so the clipped items read clearly as carousel content.
